title: Block code position count
statement: Let $n,w\in\mathbb{N}$, let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ Boolean coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$. If the number of literals in $T$ is at most $w$, then the block code formed from any set of literal positions has exactly as many positions as that set.
hypotheses_covered: The term width is at most $w$
A finite set of literal positions
